skills.name: Instrument of Fate
skills.description: Dante throws 4 spectral spears at multiple enemies, dealing physical damage and pushing the targets back.

skills.name: Instrument of Fate (Legendary)
skills.description: Whenever Dante knocks an enemy back, he gains a bonus to armor penetration for a short time.

skills.name: Foresight
skills.description: Increases all allies' Dodge for a short duration.

skills.name: Retribution
skills.description: When Dante or an ally dodges damage, Dante throws a spectral spear at the nearest enemy, dealing damage and pushing them back.

skills.name: Shackles of Weakness
skills.description: When a spectral spear hits an enemy, Dante reduces the target's main stat for a short time.

skills.name: Shackles of Weakness (Legendary)
skills.description: Extends the duration of the main stat reduction effect.

skills.name: Piercing Throw
skills.description: Every few seconds, Dante throws a spectral spear at the nearest enemy, dealing damage and knocking them back.

skills.name: Shifting Focus
skills.description: When enemies are near Dante, his Dodge increases. When no enemies are nearby, his Physical Attack increases instead.
